metadata.description: First of the three Elf-fathers who awoke at Cuiviénen. His name is Quenya for 'One, First'. Together with his spouse Iminyë, they were the first Elves to awaken. They found and awakened 6 other couples, becoming the Minyar ('Firsts') – the smallest clan with 14 members total. His direct male-line descendant was Ingwë, who became High King of all Elves. The Minyar later became known as the Vanyar, the 'Fair-elves' who dwelt in Valmar beneath the slopes of Taniquetil.
